Flow: Open end -> P8' once, makes exactly one new pipe object, and the pipe box sits at y -80112.5 like the pipe that leaves the pit. cases.proves_bugs: BUG-223 CDEDIT branch only; BUG-686 Edit Pipe zero-level branch only; BUG-1222 later plain Save regression. The CD branches are not covered. Detail: BUG-223 (CDEDIT on a pipe between two open ends, levels typed the other way round: the flow arrow follows the levels, the pipe is not left uphill without a plain warning); BUG-686 (the same with a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels). BUG-261, BUG-292 and the size-only save are in R32b, not here.
cases.title: Edit Pipe on a pipe with two free ends: levels typed the other way round turn the flow arrow, also with a level of exactly 0.00, and the IL texts follow the typed levels
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe single save (triage group K3; daily card D17 neighbour); BUG-223, BUG-686
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-223 (steps: draw a pipe between two open ends, CDEDIT it, type the levels the other way round: not uphill without a plain warning) and BUG-686 (CD or Edit Pipe flow arrow, a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md.
cases.expected: A new 20 m pipe with free ends and levels 18.000 / 17.900 has its flow arrow pointing from the first end to the second (arrow block rotation 0). CDEDIT with the levels typed 17.900 / 18.000 and Save prints "Pipe updated." and turns the arrow round (rotation about 3.1416: the pipe now falls from its second end), or says in plain words that the pipe flows uphill; it never ends uphill with no word. The same for a second pipe drawn 0.50 / 0.00 and edited to 0.00 / 0.50. The IL texts read the typed levels at the ends (IL 17.900 left and IL 18.000 right; IL 0.00 left and IL 0.50 right). No CE window is left open and the drawing file on disk is unchanged. Second, independent check (batch 3 review, 25 Oct): the left IL text (17.900 and 0.00) sits west of the pipe's middle (x below 160000) and the right one (18.000 and 0.50) east of it, and after a SECOND plain Edit Pipe save (nothing typed) the arrow is still turned round (rotation about 3.1416), so the first turn was a real change of direction, not only a redraw. On Civil 3.0.75 that last check is expected to FAIL: BUG-1222 (a later save turns the flipped arrow back).
cases.why_not_unit: The levels, the arrow block and the IL texts are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: Which way the arrow points is read from the arrow block rotation (0 = along the drawn direction, about 3.1416 = turned round); that the picture looks right is a Codex look. The size-only save is in R32b. BUG-261 and BUG-292 (a CD direction question, a plain save reversing a downstream-first pipe) are not claimed here. Pipes on pits (levels from the pits) are not driven.
